blocks.title: ♻️ REPASO EXPRESS
blocks.intro: Antes de empezar, recupera lo de la clase pasada. Une cada palabra con su significado — sin mirar atrás.

blocks.title: 🧳 TRAVEL EXPERIENCES
blocks.intro: Vocabulario para contar qué pasó en un viaje. Practica en voz alta, ¡sin traductor!
blocks.stage: ① VOCAB & GRAMMAR · experiencias + narrar

cells.body:
acciones terminadas — los hechos
We arrived, checked in, and ate.

el fondo / acción en progreso
The sun was shining. We were waiting.

acción larga interrumpida por una corta
I was walking when I heard my name.

parts.body: Past perfect (pasado anterior): "The train had already left when we got there." · used to / would (hábitos pasados): "We used to travel every summer." / "We would camp by the lake."

blocks.title: ★ THE TRIP TO PERU
blocks.intro: Max le cuenta a Ada su viaje a Perú. Primero practicas los tiempos del pasado, y luego escuchas 2 audios: una historia y una anécdota.
blocks.stage: ② THE STORY · Ada y Max

blocks.title: PAST SIMPLE or CONTINUOUS?
blocks.intro: Acción en progreso / fondo → past continuous. Hecho terminado → past simple.

items.q: We ___ at the gate when they announced the delay. (wait)
I ___ my passport on the first day. (lose)
While she ___, it started to rain. (drive)
They arrived late and ___ the tour. (miss)
The sun ___ when we left the hotel. (shine)

speaking.prompt: Cuenta una historia corta de un viaje: un problema y cómo terminó. Usa past simple + past continuous.

blocks.stage: ③ PRACTICE · elige la respuesta

blocks.title: CHOOSE THE LINKER
blocks.intro: when / while / then / suddenly / in the end.

items.q: I was reading ___ the train stopped.
___ we were walking, it started to rain.
We got a bit lost, but ___ we found the hotel.
I heard a loud noise. ___, the lights went off.
We had dinner and ___ we went straight to bed.

blocks.title: ORDENA LA FRASE
blocks.intro: Toca las palabras para formar la frase correcta.

items.answer: I was watching a film when the phone rang
While we were driving the car broke down
In the end we found the bags

blocks.title: PAST SIMPLE vs PAST CONTINUOUS
blocks.intro: Cambia una palabra y cambia el orden de los hechos. Léelas con cuidado.

pair.a: When the taxi arrived, we had breakfast.
pair.b: When the taxi arrived, we were having breakfast.

options: Antes de que llegó el taxi
Después de que llegó el taxi

items.q: Estabas conduciendo y el coche se averió. ¿Qué dices?
options: I drove when the car broke down.
I drive when the car broke down.
I was driving when the car broke down.

items.q: El vuelo salió a las nueve en punto — acción puntual. ¿Qué dices?
options: The flight was leaving at nine.

blocks.title: AUDIO 1 · THE TRIP TO PERU
blocks.desc: Max cuenta su primer día en Perú. Fíjate en qué pasó y cuándo.

questions.q: What happened while they were waiting for their bags?
options: They announced the bags were lost
They found the bags on the belt
They announced the flight was delayed

questions.q: What were they doing when the bags were found?
How was the rest of the trip?
options: A little boring after the hike

transcript.html: How was your trip to Peru?
Amazing, but the first day was crazy. We were waiting for our bags when they announced they were lost.
Oh no! What did you do?
We reported it, and while we were filling out the forms, someone found them.
I know. After that, everything went perfectly. We hiked, we ate great food. It was the best trip ever.

blocks.stage: ④ LISTENING · escucha las historias

blocks.title: AUDIO 2 · A DRIVE TO THE MOUNTAINS
blocks.desc: Alguien cuenta una anécdota. Fíjate en qué pasó y quién ayudó.

questions.q: What happened while they were driving?
options: They got lost in the mountains
It snowed on the mountain road
Great — the best part of the trip
Boring — they slept in the car
Cold and bad, with no food

transcript.html: Last summer, we drove to the mountains. While we were driving, the car broke down. It was raining, and we didn't have a phone signal. We waited for an hour, and then a farmer stopped to help us. In the end, we stayed at his house and had a great night. It was the best part of the trip!

blocks.title: ✍️ TELL A STORY
blocks.intro: Escribe una historia corta (6–8 oraciones) sobre un viaje o un día memorable, usando el pasado simple y el pasado continuo juntos, con al menos dos conectores.
blocks.placeholder: Last year, we traveled to... While we were...
blocks.example: Last año/verano, I pasado simple. The weather was … -ing. I was -ing when suddenly pasado simple. Then we ___, and in the end ___.
blocks.hw: Escribe tu historia y después grábate contándola sin leer — es una anécdota, no una lectura.
blocks.stage: ⑤ WRITING · en clase o tarea (HW)

rubric.d: Escribiste lo que pide la consigna, completo y en el formato pedido.
Usaste past simple vs. past continuous al menos 3 veces, y bien.
Se entiende sin releer: ideas unidas, sin traducir literal del español.
